description: R Statistical Analysis Software is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by The R Foundation. R is a free software environment for statistical computing and graphics. Its integrated suite of software facilities enables data manipulation, calculation, and graphical display. The environment compiles and runs on a wide variety of UNIX platforms, Windows, and MacOS. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
